name:
Article 1 – § 1 – point 5; Decision (EU) 2021/1764
Article 75 – § 1 – 87
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: 1. The indicative financial envelope for the implementation of the Programme for the period 2028-2034 shall be EUR 800 000 000 in current prices. The use of the funds shall be guided by clearly defined priorities and demonstrated needs. Before any increase in the financial allocation or any substantial reallocation of funds, an assessment of the use of funds to date and a cost-benefit analysis shall be carried out. Any increase in the financial allocation, including by using the flexibility provisions referred to in paragraph 2, shall require a separate assessment and a prior decision by the competent Union institutions. The implementation of the Programme shall be regularly assessed on the basis of measurable objectives and performance indicators. The Commission shall regularly report to the European Parliament and to the Council on the results achieved and the efficiency of the use of funds.
